figurative_meaning_en: An onomatopoeic reduplicated word indicating the sound of something rolling away
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাতাসে পাতাগুলো গড়গড় শব্দ করে উড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The leaves rustled and rolled away in the wind with a garr-garr sound.
note: This is primarily an onomatopoeic expression used in everyday descriptive contexts, rooted in Bengali phonetic traditions.
